Backend Engineer

We are a logistics company building the software that keeps warehouses running. As a Backend Engineer you will design and build services that track millions of packages a day.

You will work with Python, Postgres and Kafka, and pair closely with our data and infra teams. We value clear writing, small pull requests, and a bias toward shipping.

What you will do

  • Own services that process warehouse events in real time
  • Design schemas and APIs used across the company
  • Improve the reliability of our shipment tracking pipeline

What we are looking for

  • Several years building backend services in production
  • Comfort with SQL and relational schema design
  • A track record of shipping and owning your work end to end
